description: Fit position/velocity from 2–4 supplied azimuth/elevation tracks using constant velocity in spherical ECEF and declared angular noise/clocks. Reports fit status and conditional local uncertainty; no object identification or calibrated accuracy.

clock_offset_s.description: The observer clock is ahead of the common base by this many seconds; the engine subtracts it.

t_s.description: Seconds from a common epoch, strictly increasing for this observer.

name: triangulate_tracks
title: 3D position from several observers
